title.en: An Act Establishing the Olandang National High School in the Municipality of Midsayap, Province of North Cotabato, and Providing Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing the Olandang National High School in the Municipality of Midsayap, Province of North Cotabato, and Providing Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Olandang Quốc gia tại Đô thị Midsayap, Tỉnh North Cotabato, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Olandang แห่งชาติ ในเทศบาล Midsayap จังหวัด North Cotabato และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Olandang Nasional di Kotamadya Midsayap, Provinsi North Cotabato, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Olandang Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Midsayap, Wilayah North Cotabato, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Olandang, Municipality of Midsayap, Province of North Cotabato, to be known as the Olandang National High School under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
the amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
